**ABOUT US:**

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Network Engineer with strong expertise in, Data center & corporate office networking, and Network security operations. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and managing enterprise network infrastructure across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments. The role involves working closely with infrastructure, security, and cloud teams to ensure high availability, performance, and security of the network environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and support enterprise data center network infrastructure.
* Design, implement, and maintain VMware NSX environments including micro-segmentation and distributed firewall policies.
* Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching technologies.
* Manage firewall policies, VPNs, NAT, and security controls.
* Support data center operations including LAN, WAN,
* Knowledge in Hub-Spoke and spine-leaf architecture
* Monitor network performance, availability, and security incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis for network outages and service degradation.
* Implement high availability solutions such as HSRP, VRRP, dynamic routing, and redundancy mechanisms.
* Work on BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, LACP, and MPLS technologies.
* Coordinate with server, virtualization, cloud, and security teams for infrastructure changes.
* Manage load balancers, DNS, DHCP, and IPAM solutions.
* Handle change management, patching, upgrades, and documentation activities.
* Ensure compliance with security standards and operational best practices.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity initiatives.
* Participate in 24x7 support or on-call rotation when required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of VMware NSX-T / NSX-V.
* Experience in data center operations and enterprise networking.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco, Checkpoint, Palo Alto, ISE and WLC devices.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, and switching concepts.
* Experience with BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VXLAN, EVPN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP/Port Channel
* Experience with VPN technologies including IPsec and SSL VPN.
* Familiarity with monitoring and SIEM tools.
* Experience Managing Zero Trust and Network Segmentation technologies.
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in network engineering and data center operations.
* Good to have VMware NSX certification.
* Cisco CCNP/CCIE or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience in large enterprise or multi-data-center environments.
* Exposure to hybrid cloud networking and SDN technologies.
* Knowledge in incident management and change management processes.
* Knowledge of network security best practices and compliance frameworks.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work in fast-paced production environments.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Team collaboration and leadership capabilities.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

**Our global benefits also include:**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

title: Customer-AM&C-Aprimo-Consultant Technical Transformation
description:
**Job Title:** Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead (Sr. Consultant)
  
**Experience Required: 3-6** Years overall (minimum 3–4 years dedicated Aprimo **DAM** **and/or MRM** experience)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead to own the strategic direction, architecture, and team leadership of our enterprise Aprimo Digital Asset Management **and Marketing Resource Management** platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Architecture & Governance**

* Own the long-term architectural roadmap for the Aprimo DAM and MRM platform - taxonomy evolution, metadata schema strategy, integration architecture, and AI capability adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-wide DAM and MRM governance standards: naming conventions, field design principles, classification ownership models, and change management processes.
* Review data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures within Aprimo MRM and DAM to ensure accurate reporting, data quality, and future extensibility.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex marketing and compliance requirements into detailed Aprimo configuration blueprints and solution documents.
* Define governance guidelines for Aprimo configuration standards, naming conventions, and usage policies so that global teams follow consistent practices.

**MRM - Marketing Planning & Financial Management**

* Configure and manage Aprimo MRM's **marketing planning and budgeting modules** - including plan hierarchies, activity types, budget structures, and fiscal year setup aligned to enterprise marketing operating models.
* Design and maintain MRM financial workflows including budget request, approval, allocation, accrual, and reconciliation processes - ensuring finance and marketing teams operate from a single source of truth.
* Build and govern MRM project and activity templates that standardise how marketing programmes are initiated, tracked, and closed across global teams.
* Configure MRM work management capabilities - task management, project timelines, resource assignments, and capacity planning - to support marketing operations teams.
* Design MLR (Medical/Legal/Review) and compliance-driven approval workflows within Aprimo MRM for regulated industries, including routing rules, version locking, and audit trail requirements.
* Maintain and evolve MRM field design - custom fields, picklists, calculated fields, and conditional logic - ensuring that data captured at the plan and activity level supports downstream reporting needs.
* Define and enforce MRM data governance standards for plan naming conventions, cost centre mapping, vendor management, and invoice processing workflows.
* Configure and maintain MRM reporting and dashboard frameworks - including standard and custom reports across budget performance, activity status, resource utilisation, and campaign ROI.
* Manage MRM user role and permission architecture - defining role hierarchies, team structures, and access scoping aligned to organisational and regional team models.
* Support MRM integrations with finance and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget synchronisation, purchase order management, invoice reconciliation, and financial close processes.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of DAM Specialists, Analysts, MRM Administrators**,** and Integration Developers - setting technical direction and reviewing their configuration and integration work.
* Lead development teams by providing detailed interface specifications, mapping documents, and solution use cases that reduce implementation rework.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews for API integrations, ensuring adherence to security, performance, and maintainability standards.

**DAM Configuration & Taxonomy**

* Configure Aprimo DAM capabilities to streamline asset intake, metadata modeling, and governance processes that improve asset discoverability and reuse.
* Design and maintain a scalable, organisation-wide taxonomy (classification hierarchy) aligned to how marketing teams browse and search for assets.

**Integration Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end integration architecture connecting Aprimo to the broader MarTech and enterprise systems landscape (CMS, PIM, CRM, marketing automation, CDN).
* Design and build API-based integrations using the Aprimo REST API - including asset ingestion pipelines, metadata synchronisation, and event-driven workflows.
* **Design and build MRM API integrations** - including marketing plan data synchronisation, activity status feeds, budget and spend data pipelines, and bi-directional connectors with finance and ERP platforms.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, manage API client registrations, and maintain secure credential handling for all service accounts.
* Develop and maintain webhook configurations for event-driven integrations with downstream systems (CMS, PIM, email platforms, CDN).
* Build and maintain bulk asset ingestion pipelines handling multi-step processes: record creation, chunked file upload, metadata mapping, commit, and error handling.
* Implement and maintain the Aprimo Content Selector SDK within third-party applications - ensuring scoped authorisation, rendition control, and audit logging.

**Migration**

* Lead asset migration projects from legacy DAM systems or shared drives into Aprimo - including source audit, de-duplication, metadata mapping, and validation.
* **Lead MRM data migration projects** from legacy marketing planning tools, spreadsheets, or prior MRM platforms into Aprimo - including plan and activity data mapping, historical budget data migration, open workflow migration, and user acceptance validation.

**Aprimo certification is a plus.**

**Experience**

* 6–7 years total professional experience, including a minimum of 4–5 years of dedicated, hands-on Aprimo DAM and/or MRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the senior/lead technical resource on at least one full Aprimo implementation or major platform transformation - not merely a contributor.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Aprimo MRM modules - including marketing planning, budget management, work management, and approval workflow design - at an enterprise scale.
* Proven ownership of enterprise taxonomy and metadata architecture decisions - able to speak to specific trade-offs made and their long-term consequences.
* Deep, verifiable hands-on expertise with the Aprimo REST API - must be able to design integration architecture from scratch, not just describe individual endpoint calls.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of DAM analysts, specialists, MRM administrators, or developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare) with MLR/compliance-driven workflow design - including MRM-side review routing and audit trail configuration.
* Experience owning a DAM or MRM platform migration at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with Aprimo Content Selector SDK, Agentic Orchestration (Copilot Studio, n8n, MCP Server), and emerging AI-driven DAM capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise identity/access architecture - SCIM provisioning, SSO integration, federated permission models.
* Experience integrating Aprimo MRM with ERP or finance platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget and spend management.
* Familiarity with Aprimo MRM reporting frameworks and the ability to design custom dashboards for marketing operations and finance stakeholders.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. title: IT Technologist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Global Commercial Office (GCO) Sales Enablement organization delivers technology solutions that enable commercial teams to improve customer engagement, sales execution, and business performance. This team partners with Sales, Service, Enterprise Accounts, and Commercial Operations stakeholders to support CRM capabilities across the Americas region and advance execution excellence through scalable, reliable technology solutions.
  
This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work model. The role collaborates with globally distributed business and technology teams to ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of Salesforce applications and related business processes.
  
  
As a Salesforce QA Analyst, you will support the quality assurance lifecycle for Salesforce solutions that enable commercial business processes across the Americas. This role is responsible for test planning, test execution, defect management, release validation, and continuous improvement of quality practices to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business, functional, and technical requirements.  
  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and solution designs to define testing scope and approach.

* Develop and execute test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Perform functional, system, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing across Salesforce solutions.
* Validate Salesforce configuration, security, automation, and custom functionality including Flows, Apex, Lightning Web Components, profiles, and permission models.
* Test integrations between Salesforce and external systems using APIs and batch-processing interfaces.
* Log, track, retest, and report defects using Agile delivery and defect-management tools.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release validation, and post-deployment testing activities.
Collaborate with business analysts, developers, architects, product owners, and business users to ensure quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of software testing experience, including 2+ years testing Salesforce applications.
* Experience testing Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud environments.
* Experience creating test plans, test cases, test scripts, test data, and requirements traceability documentation.
* Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect-management tools in Agile/Scrum environments.
    
  Nice to Haves:
* Experience testing Salesforce Health Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Salesforce mobile applications.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium or Copado Robotic Testing.
* Experience with Copado or other Salesforce DevOps and release-management platforms.
* Knowledge of healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industry environments.
Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform App Builder, or related Salesforce certification.  

  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.  
‌

This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

This role requires strong technical expertise, hands-on experience with Workato, and the ability to mentor junior team members while ensuring best practices and standards are followed.

title: iCare Connect Engineer
description:
***About the job***

We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

Sanofi’s Digital organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed AI products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D and manufacturing sites. The team is located in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater and most recently, Toronto, with the aim of opening a new office in Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI to chase the miracle of science

**About Growing with us**
-------------------------

In this role you will

* Play a critical role in managing, supporting the iCare Salesforce Health Cloud Platform.
* Accountable for delivering Digital Patient Services Products and Solutions assisting Sanofi Patient Services functions.
* Leverages specialized, functional expertise for solving complex functional problems as individual or as team member.
* Leads and executes functional and technical expertise all along the lifecycle (plan, design, build, run) of Digital Patient Services leveraging Salesforce Health Cloud and managed packages.
* Provide solution guidance for highly complex business processes, regulatory (HIPAA, Data Privacy, GxP, etc.), compliance and cybersecurity processes. S/he will leverage the Digital portfolio, catalog of services, existing platforms as well as integrate new industry standards to define and implement the Patient Services products and services.

**About you**
-------------

* Lead the design of Patient Support Services (PSS) solutions for large programs, products, and projects.
* Acts as Authority and subject matter expert owing standards and practices related to Patient Services functional expertise in Salesforce.
* Work with team and fellow Engineers to track and align on solution built as part of different streams in the Program.
* Work as part of the Agile teams on large programs, governing, shaping the delivery of projects supporting design, architecture, enhancements, with focus on optimizing business processes, finding business and technical alignments across multiple therapeutic areas where possible.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design of Patient Support Services (PSS) solutions for large programs, products, and projects.
* Acts as Authority and subject matter expert owing standards and practices related to Patient Services functional expertise in Salesforce.
* Work with team and fellow Engineers to track and align on solution built as part of different streams in the Program.

title: Service Desk Specialist
description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our ET Service Desk is a global, 24x7 team that acts as the first line of defence for Deliveroo's internal technology, supporting employees across offices, care vendors, and remote locations worldwide. We work closely with Workplace Tech, Security, IAM, Networks and application owners to resolve issues end-to-end, escalating only when something is outside our tools, access or expertise.  
The team handles everything from access management for core platforms to device, basic networking and collaboration tooling issues, following robust runbooks and service management practices.  
We are a collaborative, metrics-driven group that continuously improves our knowledge base, processes and automation to deliver a consistently great experience for our internal customers.

We're looking for a **Service Desk Specialist** to join our **Service Desk** team located in **Hyderabad**. In this role, you will be owning complex tickets from first contact through to resolution and coordinating incident response for high-impact issues. You'll troubleshoot across Google Workspace, macOS, Windows, ChromeOS, MDM, Slack and core internal tools, using your depth of experience to unblock users quickly and safely.  
Beyond BAU support, you'll lead and contribute to the improvement of the projects, refine playbooks, and mentor other analysts to uplift the overall capability of the Service Desk.

Get to know our **Service Desk** team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

**Here's what your day-to-day might look like:**
------------------------------------------------

* Be the first point of contact in Operations, helping people resolve problems and delivering an excellent customer experience in a 24x7 environment.
* Take ownership of standard and complex technical issues, diagnosing, researching, tracking, and resolving them.
* Collaborate with colleagues across our global team to share knowledge and solve problems.
* Escalate and coordinate incident response for critical issues affecting the firm.
* Troubleshoot issues across hardware, software, user accounts, trading environments, operating systems, and mobile devices.
* Look for opportunities to improve how we work and share your ideas with the team and management.

**What You'll Need to Thrive**
------------------------------

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

* A passion for customer service and a commitment to delivering an outstanding support experience.
* More than four years of experience in IT Operations, IT Support, or Technical Support, working directly with users.
* A strong interest in technology and how it helps our people deliver for Deliveroo.
* Experience supporting Google Workspace (G Suite), macOS, Windows 10 and above, and MDM tools such as Mosyle and Intune.
* Experience in technical support within a growing technology company, bringing an understanding of effective service delivery.
* The ability to contribute to and lead projects that match your expertise, while guiding colleagues and sharing your knowledge.
* A collaborative approach, with experience mentoring, training, or creating knowledge resources for your team.
* Flexibility to work morning, afternoon, and night shifts as part of a 24x7 service desk supporting Deliveroo's global business.

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed**
-----------------------------------------

We'd love to hear from you if you have exposure to or experience with some of the following, you don't need to know them all:

* **Productivity and collaboration**: Google Workspace (G Suite), Slack, and Google Workspace admin tools.
* **Operating systems and devices**: iOS, macOS, Windows 11, and ChromeOS.
* **Device management**: MDM tools such as Mosyle and Microsoft Intune.
* **Service management and reporting**: Jira Service Management (JSM), Data Studio, and Looker.
* **Networking and access**: An understanding of networking fundamentals and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* **Meeting room technology**: Supporting audiovisual (AV) and video conferencing systems, particularly Google Meet.
* **Service delivery**: Familiarity with ITIL principles and IT service management practices.
* Relevant professional certifications are also welcome.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

**Solve meaningful problems at real scale**  
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.  
  
**See your impact, fast**  
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership  
environment.

**Grow through challenge and ownership**  
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

**A culture built for builders**  
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 2-3 stages.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Configuration Analyst
description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Configuration Analyst to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
We are looking for a motivated Junior SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India-based Enterprise Endpoint Management (EPM) Delivery Centre. This entry-level role will support the deployment and management of Windows endpoints for global enterprise clients using Microsoft SCCM (Configuration Manager) and Microsoft Intune, under the guidance of senior engineers. The role operates in IST-aligned shift windows supporting NTT DATA's international managed services accounts. The engineer will build foundational EPM skills, gain exposure to global delivery processes, and grow within the NTT DATA India EPM team.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Endpoint Deployment Configuration
  

* Assist senior engineers with SCCM software deployments, patch deployments, and collection management tasks for global client environments.
* Support Intune device enrollment activities including Windows Autopilot pre-staging and enrollment status troubleshooting.
* Help maintain device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and app deployments in Microsoft Intune.
* Perform basic SCCM client health checks and assist with client remediation on endpoints.
* Shadow and assist with OS deployment (OSD) task sequences and WinPE environment configuration.
* Support day-to-day endpoint monitoring activities using SCCM console and Intune portal within defined shift hours.

Patch Management Support
  

* Assist with patch deployment operations including software update group creation and deployment scheduling.
* Monitor patch compliance reports under supervision and escalate non-compliant endpoint issues to L2 engineers.
* Support maintenance window configuration and Software Update Point (SUP) synchronization activities.
* Help document patch exceptions and track remediation activities in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow or equivalent).

Operations Ticketing

title: Analyst, Information Security (GRC)
description:
Req ID: 81933

Location:

Hyderabad, Telangana, India

In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

  

Vistance is recruiting an **Analyst, Information Security (GRC)** to join our team based in **Hyderabad!**

Are you a technology professional with experience across **Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)**, including policy/standards, third-party risk management (TPRM), customer security assurance, and security standards compliance?

  

Are you excited by the challenge and reward of maturing the GRC function for a large, publicly traded company? Then Vistance Networks' Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program may be the right next step for you! The Security Analyst will help develop and maintain our security GRC function. You’ll work with members of an international team of GRC professionals spanning Vistance Networks' US and India offices.

  

**How You'll Help Us Connect the World:**

  

As a key player in Vistance Networks’ security landscape, you will collaborate with our business units, Technology, and Security teams to systematically identify security risks, catalogue them, and drive them to resolution. Your leadership in this area will be instrumental in our collective efforts to connect the world.

  

Your success in this role depends on several factors. First, you’ll bring domain expertise and relevant experience from your previous technology or security roles. At least one of your previous roles will have given you technical experience so that you can actively participate in discussions about risk and control effectiveness. Structured execution, critical thinking, attention to detail, and effective communication are the foundation of everything we do.

  

* Works with other organizational participants to implement information security policies.
* Identifies, analyzes, evaluates, and documents information security risks and controls based on established risk criteria.
* Recommends controls to mitigate identified security risks and assists with their implementation.
* Manages an exception review and approval process and ensures exceptions are documented and reviewed periodically.
* Assists with evaluating the effectiveness of the information security program by developing, monitoring, gathering, and analyzing information security and compliance metrics for management.
* Performs third-party supplier risk assessments to manage supply chain risk throughout the supplier's lifecycle. Assesses and reports on the business's risks and benefits and mandates for supplier compliance.
* Assists with review of information security sections within supplier and customer contracts, identifies opportunities, and recommends security and data privacy content accordingly.
* Applies a strong understanding of AI governance and risk management principles, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), to identify, assess, and help mitigate risks associated with the organization’s rapidly evolving use of AI.
* Supports the adoption, implementation, and continuous improvement of security and compliance frameworks, including major governance frameworks and applicable ISO standards, to strengthen the organization’s security posture and enable sustainable business growth.
* Collaborates with business, technology, legal, and privacy stakeholders to translate AI, security, and compliance requirements into practical controls that support innovation and business objectives.
* Develops and delivers information security awareness sessions that equip employees to recognize threats, follow secure practices, and understand their role in protecting organizational information and systems.
* Plans and conducts phishing simulations, analyzes results and behavioral trends, and coordinates targeted education and follow-up activities to strengthen employee resilience.
* Identifies emerging attack trends, translates relevant findings into timely employee education, and communicates threat insights, program metrics, and recommended actions to senior leadership to provide effective risk visibility and support informed decision-making.
* Participates in the company’s vulnerability remediation program by collaborating with technology and business stakeholders to prioritize and track remediation activities, address risk-based exceptions, and drive measurable reduction of security risk across the organization.
  

**Required Qualifications for Consideration:**

  

* **Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in Information Security and hands-on expertise in governance & Risk**, demonstrating increased responsibility and success in each role. **A bachelor’s degree** or equivalent professional experience is required.
* Previous professional experience with information security or other IT/technical disciplines, with the ability to communicate with a non-technical audience about relevant domain information.
* Strong communication, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
* Working knowledge of AI governance and risk management frameworks, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), with the ability to assess AI-related risks and recommend appropriate controls.
* Experience supporting, implementing, or assessing security and compliance programs aligned with governance frameworks and applicable ISO standards, such as ISO/IEC 27001, is expected.
  

**You Will Excite Us If You Have:**

  

* Previous experience working with business stakeholders to make risk trade-offs.
* Previous experience developing and tracking technical process metrics.
* Previous experience working with external vendors and customers.
* Existing domain knowledge of security GRC. Previous experience working in these areas.
* Strong communication skills.
* Preferred certifications include ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, AICPA SOC for Service Organizations certificate, ISACA AI Fundamentals or Certified in Emerging Technology credentials, and established security or GRC certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, or CISSP.
  

**Why Join Us?**

  

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.
  
  
Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Specialist , Cybersecurity Operations
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As part of the Cyber Fusion Center (CFC), the Operational Technology (OT) Cyber Security Analyst identifies, analyzes, and supports remediation of cybersecurity risk across manufacturing and OT environments. The role partners with manufacturing sites, engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, and other stakeholders to strengthen OT cyber resilience, improve cyber hygiene, and advance threat detection capabilities.
  
  
The analyst independently performs assigned cybersecurity operations, including vulnerability management, OT threat detection and analysis, incident response, security control implementation, and stakeholder coordination. The role also contributes to the ongoing development and improvement of OT cybersecurity processes, platforms, and operational capabilities.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**  

* Identify, analyze, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of OT vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations in alignment with internal risk and remediation guidelines.
* Perform vulnerability assessment activities across OT assets, applications, operating systems, and infrastructure, and work with manufacturing sites and technology owners to address identified risks.
* Operate and support OT threat detection and asset visibility platforms, including Nozomi and Armis, to identify anomalous activity, security risks, asset changes, vulnerabilities, and potential cyber threats.
* Analyze alerts and network activity from OT security monitoring platforms and perform initial investigation and triage of potential security events.
* Assist with tuning, optimization, and continuous improvement of OT threat detection capabilities, including alert logic, asset classification, vulnerability data, and monitoring coverage.
* Conduct OT threat analysis and threat hunting using available network, endpoint, vulnerability, and security telemetry.
* Investigate potential cybersecurity incidents affecting manufacturing and OT environments and coordinate escalation and response activities with applicable incident response teams.
* Correlate information across multiple security and operational data sources to identify threats, vulnerabilities, asset risks, and security control gaps.
* Execute and coordinate cyber hygiene activities across manufacturing environments, including asset inventory validation, patching coordination, backup validation, endpoint hardening, account and access reviews, and identification of unnecessary services or network communications.
* Support implementation and maintenance of OT security controls, including network segmentation, firewall rule hygiene, secure remote access, endpoint security, and vulnerability management controls.
* Use enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow to track vulnerability remediation, security issues, and risk reduction activities.
* Develop reports, metrics, and stakeholder communications related to OT vulnerabilities, threat activity, cyber hygiene, remediation progress, and security posture.
* Partner with manufacturing sites, engineering teams, and cybersecurity teams to investigate security issues and drive assigned remediation activities through completion.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate OT cybersecurity processes, detection capabilities, data integration, and reporting.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of OT cybersecurity procedures, playbooks, standards, and operational processes.
* Provide technical guidance to junior analysts and support knowledge sharing across the OT cybersecurity team.

**Education Minimum Requirement:**  

* Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT or OT security operations, network security, engineering, or a related technical field.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, network security, and security monitoring.
* Experience analyzing cybersecurity alerts, network activity, logs, or endpoint telemetry to investigate potential threats.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, network monitoring, endpoint security, vulnerability management, or threat detection platforms.
* Understanding of networking concepts, protocols, firewalls, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Ability to independently analyze technical security issues and coordinate appropriate remediation or escalation.
* Ability to analyze and correlate information across multiple technical data sources.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively across cybersecurity, engineering, infrastructure, and manufacturing organizations.

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**  

* Experience working with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) or OT environments, including PLCs, SCADA, DCS, industrial networks, or manufacturing systems.
* Experience with OT network monitoring, asset visibility, or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks or Armis.
* Understanding of OT and ICS network protocols such as Modbus, OPC, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or DNP3.
* Experience investigating cybersecurity events involving industrial or manufacturing systems.
* Experience with vulnerability management and remediation platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with OT cybersecurity frameworks and guidance such as NIST SP 800-82, IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or MITRE ATTCK for ICS.
* Experience with scripting, automation, data analysis, or querying large security datasets.
* Cybersecurity certifications such as Security, GICSP, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent.

**Who we are:**  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What we look for:**  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information:**  
**Required Skills:**  
Adaptability, Adaptability, Analytical Thinking, Corporate Security Management, Cybersecurity, Cyber Threat Hunting, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Detail-Oriented, Digital Forensics, Firewall Management, Incident/Breach Triage and Containment, Incident Response Management, Insider Threat Mitigation, Log Analysis, Malware Analysis, Network Security, Network Security Tools, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT) Security, Perimeter Security, Security Controls, Security Fundamentals, Security Incident Response, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) {+ 10 more}
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**  
Collaboration, Information Security, Network Communications

The ideal candidate will possess a strong investigative skillset, a meticulous approach to data analysis, and the ability to act decisively under pressure.

title: Specialist, Databricks Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
Our Technology Canters are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Databricks Platform Engineer to support the administration, operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our enterprise Databricks platform.
  
The ideal candidate will have experience with Databricks administration, data engineering concepts, platform observability, and technical troubleshooting. This individual will work closely with platform teams, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other technical users to maintain a reliable platform and help diagnose issues related to jobs, pipelines, compute, access, performance, and user environments.
  
  
The role is well suited for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with users, learning new technologies, and experimenting with new Databricks capabilities.
  
  
What will you do in this role
  
  
Databricks Administration Platform Operations
  
  

* Support day-to-day administration and operation of Databricks environments.
* Manage workspaces, compute resources, clusters, SQL Warehouses, jobs/workflows, libraries, and workspace configurations.
* Support user provisioning, permissions, access controls, service principals, and Unity Catalog.
* Monitor platform health, workload performance, utilization, and operational issues.
* Investigate platform and workload failures using logs, job history, compute metrics, and other diagnostic information.
* Help identify whether issues originate from compute, configuration, permissions, data, application code, or other dependencies.
* Assist with platform upgrades, configuration changes, and operational improvements.
* Maintain platform documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.

Data Engineering Workload Support
  
  

* Support data engineering workloads running on Databricks using Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Jobs/Workflows.
* Assist teams in troubleshooting failed or poorly performing data pipelines.
* Review job failures, logs, Spark execution behavior, compute utilization, data issues, and dependencies to help identify root causes.
* Work with Data Engineers to troubleshoot ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and processing issues.
* Assist with identifying performance bottlenecks and opportunities to improve workload reliability and efficiency.
* Understand basic Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture concepts and how they relate to Databricks workloads.

Platform Observability Reliability
  
  

* Monitor the health and reliability of Databricks workloads and platform services.
* Help develop and maintain monitoring and dashboards for:
* Job and pipeline failures
* Compute utilization
* Workload performance
* Platform health
* Capacity and usage
* Cost and consumption
* Assist in configuring alerts and identifying recurring failure patterns.
* Participate in troubleshooting incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Help translate recurring incidents into opportunities for automation and platform improvements.
* Work with enterprise monitoring solutions such as CloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar technologies.

User Support Troubleshooting
  
  

* Work directly with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, analysts, and other Databricks users to understand and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Support problems involving notebooks, jobs, libraries, compute, permissions, data access, Python/SQL environments, and Spark workloads.
* Guide users through appropriate troubleshooting steps and escalate complex platform issues when needed.
* Document common issues and develop reusable knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Communicate technical issues clearly to both platform teams and end users.
* Provide a positive and collaborative support experience rather than simply routing support tickets.

Data Science AI Enablement
  
  

* Support Databricks environments used by Data Science and analytics teams.
* Understand common Data Science workflows involving Python, SQL, notebooks, Spark, MLflow, and machine learning libraries.
* Assist Data Scientists with environment, library, compute, permissions, and data access issues.
* Support the configuration and operation of compute environments used for Data Science and ML workloads.
* Develop working knowledge of emerging AI/ML capabilities available within the Databricks ecosystem.

Technology Exploration Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Stay informed about new Databricks features, runtimes, administrative capabilities, and platform improvements.
* Experiment with relevant new capabilities in development or test environments.
* Participate in small proofs-of-concept to understand how new features could improve reliability, observability, cost, security, or user experience.
* Share findings with the broader platform team.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive platform administration and support activities.
* Continuously improve technical skills across Databricks, cloud, Data Engineering, and Data Science technologies.

What should you have
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Administration, or Cloud Data Platforms.
* Experience withUnity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Jobs/Workflows, and SQL Warehouses.
* 1-2 years of hands-on Databricks administration experience.
* Experience working with Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms.
* Understanding of Databricks administration and platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
* Familiarity with Apache Spark / PySpark and distributed data-processing concepts.
* Understanding of Data Engineering and ETL/ELT concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting technical issues using logs, monitoring information, and application/platform diagnostics.
* Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably AWS.
* Understanding of access management, security, and data governance concepts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical users and work collaboratively to investigate issues.
* Familiarity withGit, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code technologies such asTerraform.
* Exposure to Data Science or AI/ML workloads.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Databricks certification or related training.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such asCloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog, or Grafana.
* Familiarity withMLflow, machine learning workflows, or MLOps concepts.

  Evaluate new security technologies and recommend implementation approaches based on technical fit, business requirements, and security outcomes.
    
    
  Build proof-of-concepts, pilots, and production deployments, and develop reusable technical standards, deployment patterns, and integration architectures.
* **AI Security Engineering**
    
  Implement and manage technologies that provide visibility, governance, monitoring, and protection for AI applications, agents, copilots, and large language model environments.
    
    
  Support onboarding and integration of AI security platforms with enterprise AI technologies, custom AI workloads, and agent frameworks.
    
    
  Design and implement controls to identify, monitor, and mitigate AI-related security risks.
    
    
  Evaluate emerging AI security capabilities and open-source AI security frameworks.
* **Security Integrations & Automation**
    
  Develop integrations between security platforms and enterprise technologies using APIs, scripting, automation, and workflow orchestration.
    
    
  Build and maintain automation for security monitoring, alerting, reporting, enforcement, and remediation activities.
    
    
  Integrate security platforms with identity providers, SIEM/SOAR solutions, cloud environments, endpoint management platforms, and business applications.
    
    
  Create reusable deployment patterns, scripts, and workflows to improve scalability and operational efficiency.
* **Security Operations & Platform Management**
    
  Perform platform administration, upgrades, tuning, health monitoring, and lifecycle management.
    
    
  Administer and optimize Wiz and other CNAPP/CSPM capabilities, including connector health, cloud coverage, security policies, risk prioritization, dashboards, reporting, and integration with operational workflows.
    
    
  Troubleshoot complex technical issues related to security platform deployments and integrations.
    
    
  Manage vendor relationships and collaborate with product engineering and implementation teams to address technical challenges and roadmap requirements.
    
    
  Maintain platform documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation guides, and operational procedures.
    
    
  Support incident investigations and security assessments requiring expertise in deployed platforms.
* **Research & Innovation**
    
  Research emerging security technologies, open-source tools, and industry innovations.
    
    
  Conduct technical assessments, proof-of-concepts, and comparative evaluations of new products.
    
    
  Stay current with advancements in AI security, cloud security, identity security, and automation technologies.
    
    
  Contribute to future security capabilities and strategic security initiatives.

**The team**

At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas—Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate—together we live, breathe, and deliver the Deloitte experience.

We offer well-being programs and continuously seek new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and enables our people to excel and lead healthy, happy lives.

**Corporate citizenship**

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skills-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.

  
  

**Location: Hyderabad**

  
  

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST**

Required:

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, cloud security, security automation, or enterprise security platform administration, including hands-on responsibility for implementing and operating security technologies in complex environments.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Overview:

**About JAGGAER**  
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com

**Cyber Security Analyst**

**The Role**  
Reporting to the Manager, IR & Assurance, the Cyber Security Analyst is a core member of the JAGGAER Security Operations Centre (SOC). The analyst shares the day-to-day threat analytics, security event triage, investigation, and incident response that protect JAGGAER's corporate and production environments across on-premise and cloud systems.  
This is a hands-on mid-level operational role. The analyst works as part of a small, close-knit team where everyone shares the core SOC responsibilities. As the analyst develops, they may take ownership of a specialism (for example threat intelligence, threat hunting, or incident response) at approximately 20% of their time, on top of the shared core. This role is based in Hyderabad, India, with hybrid working, and operates within standard working hours.

  
Principal Responsibilities:

**Core Responsibilities (Shared by All Analysts)**  
The core SOC responsibilities are shared across the team. The analyst will:

* Alert triage — Triage and validate security escalations from CrowdStrike Falcon Complete (MDR) and internal sources, prioritising by severity and logging a clear outcome for each.
* Investigation — Investigate confirmed and suspected incidents to establish scope, impact, and root cause, using structured, evidence-based methodology.
* Incident response — Contain, respond to, and document security incidents in line with the Incident Response Procedure — isolating hosts, blocking indicators, and coordinating remediation.
* Correlation & hunting — Correlate activity across CrowdStrike NGSIEM, Observe and the endpoint tooling (CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Defender), using Zscaler VPN data for IP and connection analysis, and hunt for anomalies not surfaced by automated detection (failed logons, privilege escalation, new admin accounts).
* Phishing response — Review and action user-reported phishing (including via PhishER), confirm remediation, and initiate takedowns of malicious domains and leaked credentials.
* Production alignment — Align SOC investigations with security-related production incidents to ensure no coverage gaps between operations and security.
* Detection support — Feed investigation findings, including false positives and coverage gaps, back to the team to inform detection tuning.
* Documentation — Maintain accurate, complete records in Jira and the IR record for all work, and complete daily operational checks and handover.

  
Position Requirements:

**What You Will Bring**  
Essential  

* 3+ years' experience in, or closely related to, the cybersecurity field, with hands-on security operations experience.
* Understanding of Microsoft Windows and Linux/Unix system-level security controls.
* Understanding of common threat-actor techniques, malware behaviour, and persistence mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including alert triage, host investigation and response actions such as containment.
* Practical experience with SIEM platforms, including alert triage, event investigation, and documentation. CrowdStrike NGSIEM or comparable technology.
* Practical experience using AI tools to support security work, such as summarizing alerts, drafting queries or analyzing logs, with the judgement to verify output and to keep sensitive data out of unapproved tools in line with company policy.
* Structured, evidence-based investigation approach with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work as part of a close-knit team, sharing the core workload and supporting colleagues.

**Desirable**  

* Experience with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat intelligence in operational practice.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike NGSIEM, including CQL query writing, log ingestion concepts and detection rule structure.
* Experience working alongside a managed detection and response (MDR) provider.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Mimecast or phishing-response tooling such as KnowBe4 PhishER.
* Scripting (Python or PowerShell) to automate repetitive triage tasks.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure, O365, AWS).
* Interest in developing a specialism (CTI, threat hunting, or IR).
* Relevant industry certifications held or in progress — for example CompTIA Security+, Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1), or ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC). Professional membership (ISC2, ISACA) is welcomed.
* Red/Blue team exposure.

**How You Will Grow**  
The Cyber Security Analyst role sits on a clear progression path: Cyber Security Analyst Senior Cyber Security Analyst Lead Cyber Security Analyst, aligned to the NIST NICE and ENISA ECSF frameworks. Progression is evidence-based. Analysts are encouraged to develop a specialism as they grow, held as additional ownership alongside the shared core.

**What We Offer:**
  
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

Our Values - T.E.A.M:  
At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.  

* Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

**EEO:**
  
JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Great Place to Work® Certified 2026 – JAGGAER**

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first.

We are proud to announce that **JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026**, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high-performing culture.

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a SOC Analyst (L1.5) with hands-on experience in Security Operations, Security Monitoring, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and SIEM technologies. Candidates with strong experience in Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or ArcSight along with incident response and threat hunting capabilities will also be considered.

description:
**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

**Process Overview**

Transaction Reporting Control Group are responsible for ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the Bank’s transaction reporting obligations across multiple global regulatory jurisdictions. Completeness, accuracy, and timeliness controls are the primary responsibility of 2 core functions within the Transaction Reporting Control Group team. The Submission Control function is responsible for monitoring and remediating the internal validation failures and the rejects (NACKs) from the regulators, the team must liaise with MO/FO/Tech teams for the root causes of the exceptions. Submission control also monitors the trades which are not getting reported within the compliance time for OTC/ETD/Securities and raise breaches for all timeliness issues that missed the agreed thresholds. The Enhanced Quality Assurance team perform post process testing to validate the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the transaction reports submissions through performing reconciliations and targeted deep dive sample-based QA testing.

  
  

**Job Description**

The current role is for the Enhanced Quality Assurance and below is the description of the role.

* Good understanding of Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reporting landscape, along with knowledge of other key jurisdictions such as SFTR, EMIR, and HKMA.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Material Terms Reconciliation process, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of reconciliation breaks across regulatory jurisdictions.
* Strong working knowledge on TriOptima and DTCC platforms, with hands-on experience in break analysis, matching logic and resolution.
* Manage daily BAU activities, monitor exception queues, and drive closure of aged and high-risk material terms breaks.
* Provide oversight and guidance to analysts on break investigation, root cause analysis, and remediation strategies.
* Engage with internal stakeholders, technology teams, and counterparties to resolve data quality and reporting discrepancies.
* Track key performance metrics, prepare MI reports, and provide regular updates to management on reconciliation trends, risks, and remediation progress.
* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities, and control enhancements to improve reconciliation accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory reporting requirements and maintain appropriate audit trails and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate issue escalations, prioritize critical breaks, and facilitate timely resolution to minimize regulatory and operational risk.
* Support new regulatory initiatives, system changes, and testing activities impacting the Material Terms Reconciliation process.
* This is a very hands-on role, ideal for someone with drive and willingness to learn and adapt, is proactive and has very good knowledge about the reporting regulation and the reporting system architecture
  

  

**Responsibilities**

* Ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of transaction reporting submissions across multiple regulatory regimes (e.g. CFTC, EMIR, MIFID, SFTR, HKMA etc.)
* Engagement in designing, implementing, and maintaining operation process and controls
* Generate sample from reports and analyze patterns to derive meaningful information
* Management reporting and issue escalation and resolution
* Remaining current on the Regulatory Reporting landscape to ensure the firm’s reporting remains in step with changes in regulatory environment
* Responsible for working closely with GTR and Industry Working Groups (WG)
* Track the progress of the implementation of changes and work closely with various teams in FO/MO/Dev teams and Reporting Dev team
* Document errors as per the guidelines and ensure remediation of the issue. Raise technology requirement JIRAs. Hands-on experience in validating user acceptance test results
* Investigate and identify the root cause for the Transaction Reporting breaks and coordinate with FO/MO/Tech to fix them
* Review controls on regular basis and challenge status quo
* Work with change and initiative team on new changes and provide requirement for controls ahead of going live with new jurisdiction.
  

  

**Requirements**

**Education :** Post-Graduation

**Certifications If any :** NA

  
  

**Experience Range** : 5-8 Years of overall experience
